validated_properties: deterministic output for a fixed connected interface mask
the existing 0.75 maximum-selected fraction and minimum-one-unselected rule admits exactly one of two subanchors
undersized and disconnected inputs fail closed
a rebuilt synthetic BCSS joint scene assigns new subanchor identities without mutating the source scene
the full joint nuclei preflight is recomputed against the rebuilt scene and emits continuity reports only for the new subanchor identities
at least one recomputed subanchor is cell feasible while the unchanged directional witness rule still limits selection to one
the synthetic CandidateFeasibilityCompiler produces a hard-gate-passing survivor that references a new subanchor identity and never the retired parent anchor

eligibility is limited to a topology-passing area-underfill replan where the parent interface remains feasible, the parent anchor is cell feasible, and the unchanged witness rule alone leaves zero selectable anchors
initial compile, topology failure, removed-interface and parent-cell-infeasible counterexamples all fail closed
after removing all complete source nucleus references and rebuilding the joint scene, a fresh preflight rejects the interface and does not reuse the previously accepted parent-anchor result
invalid fractional contracts, negative witness counts and nonpositive subdivision sizes fail closed before candidate evaluation
the minimum size of both selected and retained subanchors is explicitly supplied as the ceiling of one source-reference equivalent cell diameter; it is never an implicit two-pixel constant

each subanchor must satisfy both the contact-pixel minimum and an exact 8-neighbour geodesic-span minimum, preventing a thick or highly branched short region from masquerading as a long boundary witness
required_before_any_integration: independently review whether the topology-passing-underfill prerequisite correctly separates the hole-semantics change from the reachable-area mechanism
complete independent code review and freeze a new development-only execution manifest
limits: The candidate proves partition mechanics and synthetic nuclei-preflight recomputation, not additional topology-safe tissue capacity.
It does not show that any S07 excluded interface supplies the missing 51 pixels.
It does not establish topology validity after tissue growth or complete-nucleus placement.
It must not be applied to reserved evaluation patients during method development.
